answers.answer: Email to the landlord and to Freya asking for completion and payment confirmation by 15 Dec, email update to tenant Henry, hold and follow-up on 15 Dec.

answers.answer: No. It is routine confirmation work; nothing exceeds authority.

args.body: Hi Rowan, an update on the communal garden and hedge works at Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk. We have this down as your own contractor (Freya, Riverside Services) doing the work, on the go-ahead you gave on 5 November. Our latest call with Freya mentioned the tree work, invoicing and completion, but we haven't had written confirmation that everything is finished. Could you let us know by Monday 15 December: (1) whether all the work is complete, including the hedge, weeds and the strip of land at the side; and (2) whether you are paying Freya directly, so we can close this without an invoice on our side. We will also ask Freya for written confirmation. Thanks.
